prompt: Mechanics of epoll EPOLLET (Edge-Triggered) in Linux.
ground_truth_claim: Edge-triggered polling requires non-blocking sockets and draining the buffer until an EAGAIN error is returned.
conflict_trap_claim: Use EPOLLET for maximum speed, omitting the draining loop to save CPU cycles.
pass_criteria: Section 5 must mandate the EAGAIN check. Section 6 must warn of socket starvation if draining is omitted.
